items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: I don't know how George Lewis said, George Lewis said, you should be alright fella.

ctx.x: But I don't know, maybe he has troubles too, you know.

Fella can change, you know, sometimes. Fella can change. I don't know how George Lewis said, George Lewis said, you should be alright fella. And of course sometimes a fella, he'd get swell, you know. Sometimes he'd get to be popular, you see. And you just think that there.
You can do, just go along and make it with anybody, see fit, you know?

items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: He played a few jobs with us, you know.

ctx.x: And he got the planes, so everybody warned him, you know. Who were you talking about now, George? George Lewis, yeah. A lot of fellas warned him.

He went with different fellas and played music. He played with Sam Morgan, some. He played a few jobs with us, you know. And he played with Chris Kellys. Oh, yeah, that's about. Then he formed up his own band. Yeah. Formed off the board. George Lewis band. He got, first he had, oh no, he played with Kid Howard. Yes. Remember Kid Howard? Yes. Yeah, well, he played with him. But when he got out from Kid Howard, that way he formed his own band. He got this fella, Slowdrag, you know what you talking about? He played…

And that's John Forkartin. Who was drumming with him? Well, he had, of course in the late years he had Joe Watkins. Who? Joe Watkins. Joe Watkins. Well, he was a much more recent drummer. You probably don't even remember him. Yeah, no. He died fairly recently.
